description: Checks pasted SRT or WebVTT subtitle text and lists problems per subtitle: overlapping or out-of-order timings, gaps shorter than the minimum frame gap, reading speed (characters per second), line length, line count, too short or too long durations, and broken characters from a wrong encoding (mojibake such as 'Ã©' or 'â€™', with the probable correct text). Optionally returns a corrected SRT. The text is only processed for this response.

fps.description: Video frame rate used for the minimum gap. Default 25.

include_fixed_srt.description: Also return a corrected SRT (encoding fixed, overlaps trimmed, long single lines split, short subtitles extended). Default false.

min_gap_frames.description: Minimum gap between subtitles in frames. Default 2.

preset.description: Rule set: 'netflix' (42 chars/line, 2 lines, 17-20 CPS, 0.83-7 s; default), 'vertical' (short-form vertical video: 32 chars/line, 2 lines, 17-20 CPS, 1-5 s) or 'children' (42 chars/line, 13-17 CPS).

srt_text.description: Full text of the .srt or .vtt file.

name: validate_srt
title: Validate SRT or WebVTT subtitles
